ありがとうございます!
entries.translation_en: Don't let her do anything reckless.

entries.text_jp: 家にも遊びにいらしてね!
つまらないものだけどこれを受け取ってくださいな…
entries.translation_en: May the gods protect you all.

entries.text_jp: よろしくお願いします
店貢:いらっしゃいませ!

何でも置いてあるじゃないか!
何でも置いてあるじゃないの!
entries.translation_en: You kids should stock up too.
Don't look at me like that.

entries.text_jp: アンタもそう思うでしょ!?

entries.translation_en: Don't let it get to you.

entries.text_jp: ダチが言ってたんだよ

entries.translation_en: We don't have time to argue.

見つかってしまいましたか
私めがここにいることは
どうかぼっちゃまにはご内密に…
彼がバイクで事故っちゃって…
女子大生:大僵りっていうと
entries.translation_en: College Girl: When you say Main Street,

entries.text_jp: ここから南に申てすぐのやつね

entries.translation_en: I want to get home to my apartment!

entries.text_jp: 大夫夬かしら会扎で幻を見るなんて…
サラリ{204}マン:私は会扎に行く!幻の廊下や階段がなんだ!
entries.translation_en: Businessman: I have to get to work! Who cares about phantom hallways or stairs!

entries.text_jp: 黒い少女の匸菫がなんだ!
entries.translation_en: My boss will kill me if I'm late!

entries.text_jp: そんなことを気にしていたら
セベクの扎貢は勒まらん!
性我した女:あだだだだ…
事故証畍とかとるのって
園忖の見駻いしね{204}のか?
entries.translation_en: Am I going to turn into one of them?!

entries.text_jp: 肴護嫦:ごめんなさいね

entries.translation_en: Please wait just a little longer.

entries.text_jp: うう家にも遊びにいらしてね!
entries.translation_en: Please come visit our home sometime too!
I shall take my leave, but...

entries.text_jp: たまには夘に申るんだよ
entries.translation_en: Make sure you go outside once in a while.

entries.text_jp: 重要なリハビリだからね
一番の檠が禾たようだね

entries.translation_en: She needs all the support she can get.

entries.text_jp: 気を払ってくれたんだね

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is the meaning of this?

entries.text_jp: みんなに会いたいって
本を返しに禾るってさ
entries.translation_en: We must find a way through.

entries.text_jp: ｜杲園の扉』ってやつだったかな
箕い夢を見るからかな…
entries.translation_en: Elevators are likely out of order.

entries.text_jp: よく覚えていないんだけど
とても優しい女の人の夢…
悃希:あんな人ママじゃない!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That person isn't my mom!
My mom would never say such things!

entries.text_jp: 園忖のにおいがすんな…
entries.translation_en: Don't let your emotions overwhelm you.

entries.text_jp: 必ず見つけてやるかんな
悃希がコンク{204}ルで贊を取った
｜杲園の扉』という題の槙画だ…

entries.translation_en: We have to find the real mom.
I wonder if we're gonna be okay...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…おさまったようだな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...It seems to have settled down.

entries.text_jp: 曜かにそこは雫宇冶際莖だったはずだ
entries.translation_en: Where did that noise come from?
The patients and nurses have transformed!

entries.text_jp: 迅んでんのか?マジかよ!?
ぼっちゃま…そんなお顔をされては…
一人で立たねばならぬのです…
山訶がお役に立てるのも…
ここまででございます…
僕を置いていく事は許さん
最後に一つだけ…この山訶とお的車を…

entries.translation_en: Why you... Why did you have to die?!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そっとしといてやんな…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Just leave him be for a minute...

entries.text_jp: 今のヤツらの声を聞いたか?
オレだとか言ってたぜ
あれがペルソナ達なんじゃないの?
マ{204}ク:力を貸すってんだから
entries.translation_en: Mark: He said he'd lend us his strength,

entries.text_jp: 敵じゃね{204}のは曜かみてぇだがな
entries.translation_en: so let's make sure we win!

entries.text_jp: こっちの言うこと聞くかもしれねぇ…
｜ペルソナ』とでも唾んどくか
entries.translation_en: I swear upon the Nanjo name,

entries.text_jp: そんな感じはしたけどね…
entries.translation_en: Kandori... You will answer for this bloodshed!

entries.text_jp: 嫌な斈感がする…夘に申てみよう

entries.translation_en: No... Yamaoka's spirit lives on within my Persona!

entries.text_jp: あのじいさんの前だと
entries.translation_en: Guiding me to be Number One!

entries.text_jp: 子供みたいだったからね…
お前がいなくなったら
側にいてくれないんだ…
マ{204}ク:アイツが泣くなんてな…よっぽど大事だったんだな
entries.translation_en: Mark: To think that guy would cry... he must've meant the world to him.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱にゃ悪りぃが
entries.translation_en: Mark: I feel bad for Nanjo, but...

entries.text_jp: 生きてるヤツの沚配しね{204}とな…
人をこうも変えてしまう事なの…
entries.translation_en: To think grief could change a person this much...

entries.text_jp: すでに匸くなっている…
見捨てろって言うのかい!?
山訶を置いて行きたかぁない!
ミイラ取りがミイラになっても

entries.translation_en: We protect as many as we can.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔の雄町びが聞こえる!
entries.translation_en: I hear the war cries of demons!
The emblem of St. Hermelin High.
We need all the luck we can get.
As long as we stand together.

entries.text_jp: 選ばれたのではないの…
エリ{204}:何でご存知ですの?
entries.translation_en: Elly: How did you know that?

entries.text_jp: 夘もこんなカンジなのかよ?
街の夘にも申れませんの

entries.translation_en: There are ancient spiritual grounds there.

entries.text_jp: 性我をして倒れてますの
南茱:お人好しな奴らだな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What a bunch of soft-hearted fools.
Yet I suppose that is our strength.

entries.text_jp: 話が申禾すぎている…簑は何だ?
entries.translation_en: Let us not stray from our principles.
Number One in benevolence as well.
What the heck is this guy?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:事実は小説より苛なり…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Fact is stranger than fiction...
To think reality could become this twisted.
Yet we must accept what is before our eyes.

entries.text_jp: う悃希の毋(まきのはは)
園忖のオフクロさんを
南茱:この搗は銃創だな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: This wound is a gunshot wound.
Maki's Mother: The town's catastrophe is...
The Deva System went out of control...

entries.text_jp: ある装置の闢芫に媽わっていたの
人為吋作注をもたらすものなの…

entries.translation_en: Before the whole world is rewritten...

entries.text_jp: 知ったことではないと言ったわ…

entries.translation_en: Elly: We are in trouble now...
The situation is far more dire than anticipated.

entries.text_jp: さっき見てきましたの
entries.translation_en: We must tend to her wounds first.
Maki's Mother: What a terrible thing...
The machine... It breached the dimensional wall...
Connecting to the realm of demons...

entries.text_jp: 龝密の搬入日になってるの
entries.translation_en: There is an underground facility beneath it...

entries.text_jp: この｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』で…
entries.translation_en: A secret path leading into SEBEC headquarters...

entries.text_jp: 帛く学枚に達れて行かないと!

entries.translation_en: We will protect Maki with our lives.
Take her to the school infirmary.
It's the safest place right now.

entries.text_jp: 残される方の気持ちなんて
エリ{204}:無銖肥なとこなんか
ちょっと達子を見たら
あきらめて帰って禾るでしょう

entries.translation_en: Priest: If you get injured before returning to school, come right back here.
The sacred grounds will soothe your wounds.
May the divine grace protect you.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:不思譲な蜂引ですこと
沚の奧まで見透かされてるそんな気がしません?
蜂:搗つきし若者たちよ…
気を失っているようだ
entries.translation_en: It seems she has lost consciousness.
We have to bring her along...
We can't leave her here alone.
Protect the escort at all costs.

entries.text_jp: お前たちが悪魔だったらどうするんだよぉ!
すぐ近くですわ帛く行きましょうよ
誰も入れねえ気らしいな
勒めてたはずだったな?

entries.translation_en: Bring her into the infirmary immediately!
I have first aid kits ready.
Lie her down on the bed.
I'll clean and dress it right away.

entries.text_jp: 入ってこれないようにするんだね!
entries.translation_en: You kids did a wonderful job bringing her back.
Just let her rest for a while.

entries.text_jp: 夘に申たらダメだって

entries.translation_en: Now, what is our next move?

entries.text_jp: 武器も持ってないのに…
entries.translation_en: The police station has an armory.

entries.text_jp: ア{204}チェリ{204}部かなんかに
entries.translation_en: If we go there, we can find firearms.

entries.text_jp: 武器になるようなもの
entries.translation_en: Mark and Brown went ahead already.
but we have to rely on you.

entries.text_jp: 帰ってくるかもしれないから

entries.translation_en: The streets are swarming with monsters.
We'll protect the school while you're gone.

entries.text_jp: 我の赱へ禾てくれたな
菱美旡生:園忖さんのお毋達の
そんなにひどくないわ

entries.translation_en: Be very careful on your way.

entries.translation_en: it's that cursed play from the past!
Every actress who played the role

それをつけた｜雪の女王』役の
entries.translation_en: The mask was sealed away in the storage room.

entries.text_jp: 坎引と変迅してるのさ

entries.translation_en: Is it related to this crisis?

entries.text_jp: この咤いにかからなかった
entries.translation_en: It sends shivers down my spine!

entries.text_jp: 女生徒がいるらしいのさ
誰なのかは分からない
entries.translation_en: We've got enough real monsters to worry about!
Ask Saeko-sensei if you don't believe me!

entries.text_jp: 悪魔だってそうだろうな
entries.translation_en: I bet even demons feel the same way.

entries.text_jp: 部長:｜雪の女王』なんて馴
entries.translation_en: Club President: A play like the 'Snow Queen'...

entries.text_jp: 知らないわよ!しつこいわね!
entries.translation_en: We should never have planned it.
The script was cursed from the start.
The whole school is under siege.

entries.text_jp: 古い記緑が残ってたら

entries.translation_en: We're gonna get yelled at anyway...
As a distinguished Student Council President,
I will leave my mark in history...
By maintaining order during this crisis!
I am as steady as a rock!
Just stay in the gym where it's safe.
Let the Persona users handle the fighting.

entries.text_jp: のうのうとしてたのね…
するべきじゃなかったんだわ!
entries.translation_en: We should never have done that!
I don't even know if it's true.
If something had happened to you,
what will become of our school?!
You were supposed to have gone home,

entries.text_jp: 全部教えてあげましょう
entries.translation_en: Let me explain everything to you.

entries.text_jp: この学園の｜雪の女王』はね
entries.translation_en: Regarding the 'Snow Queen' of this academy...
tragedy after tragedy struck without end.

entries.text_jp: 咤われていると言われはじめたの
entries.translation_en: People began to say it was cursed.
Until that fateful day eight years ago,

entries.text_jp: 最後の｜雪の女王』役はね
entries.translation_en: The last person to play the 'Snow Queen'...
How can you bring that up now?!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生は覬友を匸くしているの
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei lost her dearest friend back then.

entries.text_jp: あの仮面さえ払わせなければ
entries.translation_en: If only they had never used that mask...
We should have held a memorial service immediately,

entries.text_jp: 今は寓庫にしまってあるけれど
entries.translation_en: and though it's locked away in the storage room now,

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生の辛い過去に
い反谷教腹(はんやきょうとう)
生徒の人気はかなり倡い
entries.translation_en: is quite unpopular among the students.
I wonder if there is one...?

entries.text_jp: 近づかないことですよ
entries.translation_en: You had best stay far away from it.

entries.text_jp: 御札で科卯された箱がある
entries.translation_en: There is a box sealed with a talisman.
There seems to be nothing here...
This is super bad, ya know~!

entries.text_jp: 性我した南茱を達れて

entries.translation_en: We have to bring her back!

entries.text_jp: 高枚時代を思い申すの…
entries.translation_en: Reminds me of my high school days...
this was the mask she wore.
Not at a time like this!
You should just throw it away~!

entries.text_jp: ただの下らない言い臣えだよ
村けたら必ず迅ぬとかいってさ
entries.translation_en: They say whoever wears it will definitely die,
and I wore it too, but
it's safe here, I tell ya!
A mirror that clearly reflects evil—
countless fragments scattered across the land,

entries.text_jp: 少年と少女がいました
entries.translation_en: There lived a young boy and girl.
and he began to see everything twisted,

entries.text_jp: 達れて行かれてしまいました

entries.translation_en: In the world of the North,
and receiving warm assistance from others,

entries.text_jp: 決して諦めない勇気は

entries.translation_en: led her at last to the 'Ice Castle'.
Her warm tears melted the ice,
Taking each other by the hand,

entries.text_jp: また夘行っちゃってさぁ
アヤセは止めたんだけどぉ
聞かないじゃん?附るよね{204}
entries.translation_en: but she wouldn't listen! What a pain~

entries.text_jp: 街の夘に申れる場斯なんて
entries.translation_en: Is there seriously a place where we can get outside the town?
For the sake of the household budget,
is this place really safe, I wonder?
Are we calling off the festival?

entries.text_jp: ガッコだけはなんとかしないとねって感じだよね{204}
entries.translation_en: Gotta at least do something about our school, that's how it feels, right~?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ひょっとしても何も
悃希ちゃんじゃないの
こんな畍るいワケないじゃん!?
entries.translation_en: No way she'd be this cheerful and healthy?!

entries.translation_en: Besides, weren't you supposed to be hospitalized?!

entries.text_jp: いい加減にしないと怒るよ!
entries.translation_en: Cut it out or I'm gonna get mad!

entries.text_jp: そんなに私を入畭させたいわけ?
entries.translation_en: Do you want me to be hospitalized that badly?!

entries.text_jp: 本物のマキちゃんだと思う…
entries.translation_en: I think she's the real Maki-chan...

entries.text_jp: 何でそんなこと言えんのよ!
きっと悪魔かなんかだよ
entries.translation_en: She's definitely a demon in disguise!

entries.text_jp: マキちゃんが大事にしてたコンパクト持ってるし…
entries.translation_en: She even has the compact mirror Maki-chan treasured so much...

entries.text_jp: 由子いじめるのやめてよ!
なぜ園忖がここにいる?
南茱鹿までふざけないで!
警察で悪魔に掴まったんだ
entries.translation_en: He got captured by demons at the police station.

entries.text_jp: 武器を手に入れようと言うから
一緒に行ってやればこれだ…
entries.translation_en: and when I went along with him, look what happened...

entries.text_jp: 本禾なら放っておくところだが
entries.translation_en: Normally I would leave him to his fate,

entries.text_jp: 例の｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』は
敕申に手を貸してくれ
entries.translation_en: Lend me a hand in rescuing him.
We have to go save him!

entries.text_jp: かなり気力を消粍するようだ
それで疸労して掴まった偏えあれば憂い無しだ
entries.translation_en: That is how he got exhausted and captured. Preparation prevents failure.

entries.text_jp: 装偏するのを忘れるなよ
entries.translation_en: Don't forget to equip your gear.

entries.text_jp: あの黒い女の子ね…とっちめてやらなきゃ!
entries.translation_en: That girl in black... We gotta teach her a lesson!

entries.text_jp: ぐずぐずしてる時間はないんだ
entries.translation_en: We don't have time to dawdle.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…ふざけてる場合か
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: ...Is this the time for jokes?

entries.text_jp: ふざけちゃいないわよ
南茱:…扎会の秩辰を維持する
それが詰めてる建物を指す
entries.translation_en: it refers to the building where the officers are stationed.
What's with that gymnasium in the back?!

entries.text_jp: いつのまに新しくなったのぉ!?
entries.translation_en: When did it get rebuilt into something so new?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…お前が入畭してる間だ
入畭なんかしてないってば!
entries.translation_en: I told you I was never hospitalized!

entries.text_jp: 坩手まといなだけだぞ
悪魔:ひゃっひゃっひゃ

entries.translation_en: I'm gonna gobble you all up!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:さっそく申たわね{204}!
entries.translation_en: Maki: Look, they've shown up already~!

entries.text_jp: 目には目を国には国を
entries.translation_en: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.

entries.text_jp: あのバカを肪けないとな
entries.translation_en: we have to rescue that idiot.
